stations.title: Imran
stations.say: Ring the alarm, but only once.
stations.note: A leak means a hose left on.

stations.title: The logger box
stations.text: One script, and it falls over at a bad line.

stations.title: Shed alarm
stations.text: Rings at the first leak, then stays quiet.

captions: At Marrowfield, Imran wants the shed alarm to ring when a tap runs far too fast.
Today one script does everything with each line, and a half-written line stops it.
You write a meter that emits events, and a script that listens, in four tasks.
Now the first leak rings the alarm once, and every reading is still counted.
Same burst hose, same log. The alarm rings once, and Imran gets the counts.
